final_note: You can name the four main therapy types and what they treat.

concepts.def: Talking therapy changing thoughts and behaviour.
Drug raising serotonin to treat depression.

walkthroughs.body_html: CBT targets faulty thinking. The therapist helps the client identify negative automatic thoughts and replace them with realistic ones. Behavioural tasks (homework) test the new beliefs. NICE recommends CBT for depression and anxiety.
SSRIs (e.g. fluoxetine) raise serotonin to treat depression. Antipsychotics reduce dopamine to treat schizophrenia. Drugs work fast but may have side effects and do not address underlying thoughts.

Used for phobias. The client builds a hierarchy from least to most scary, learns relaxation, then works up the hierarchy while staying relaxed. Counter-conditioning replaces fear with calm at each step.
